title: Type the Amplify client and remove any from the data layer; add eslint, prettier and stricter tsconfig
description:
`client()` returns `any` (`web/src/data/client.ts:25,79,93`) even though `Schema` is imported at line 5, so every `client().models.X.op()` call is untyped. There are 99 `any` uses in `web/src`, 44 in `data/domain.ts` (`errors as any` on every result) and 30 in `data/plans.ts`. There is no eslint, prettier, biome or editorconfig in the repo. `web/tsconfig.json` has `strict` but not `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noUnusedLocals`, `noUnusedParameters`, `noImplicitReturns` or `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, and its `include` is only `src`, so `test/` and `amplify/` are never type-checked in CI. `(window as any).apricity` exposes internals in production (`main.ts:41`). localStorage access is duplicated with its own try/catch in `main.ts`, `docs.ts:61-74`, `score.ts:138-162` and `ranked-list.ts:50-60`.

Done when: `generateClient<Schema>()` is typed and the data layer has no `any`; eslint and prettier run in CI; the stricter flags are on; `test/` and `amplify/` are type-checked; one storage helper is shared.
